policy: Both arrays are intentionally empty for preview and must block production release. Preview may use the safe engineering-confirmation fallback. A concrete direction requires a version-bound active directionApproval joining one reviewed route, one exact processVariant, one applicable reviewed candidate and one approved capability with structured typicalCapacity. Active approvals are unique by routeId+processVariantId+candidateId. Product pages may supply official names and product IDs, but must never be used to infer allowed processes, atmosphere, cooling, dimensions, load or production mode.
